title: Oozing Chocolate American Cacao Dessert
description: A silky and nutty American dessert featuring cacao, coconut cream, and a hint of spice, perfect for satisfying your sweet tooth.

ingredients.name: unsweetened cocoa powder
ingredients.notes: high-quality cocoa powder for best flavor

ingredients.name: coconut cream
ingredients.notes: full-fat coconut cream for silky texture

ingredients.name: maple syrup
ingredients.notes: grade A amber maple syrup for rich flavor

ingredients.name: coconut oil
ingredients.notes: unrefined coconut oil for healthy fats

ingredients.name: vanilla extract
ingredients.notes: high-quality vanilla extract for depth of flavor

ingredients.name: pinch of salt
ingredients.notes: sea salt or flaky salt for balance of flavors

ingredients.name: chopped pecans
ingredients.notes: freshly toasted pecans for added crunch

instructions: In a medium saucepan, melt the coconut oil over low heat.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the cocoa powder, maple syrup, and a pinch of salt.
Add the coconut cream to the saucepan with the melted coconut oil and stir until smooth.
Add the cocoa mixture to the coconut cream mixture and stir until well combined.
Add the vanilla extract and stir to combine.
Pour the mixture into individual serving cups or a large serving dish.
Top with chopped pecans and refrigerate for at least 2 hours.
